gloss: corn soup; cream of corn soup

definitions.explanation: A thick, mildly sweet soup made from sweetcorn. In Japan it is a standard item on family-restaurant and set-meal menus, a common instant-soup and vending-machine drink in winter, and one of the first soups children learn to like.

examples.japanese: コーンスープを{飲|の}んだ。
{寒|さむ}い{日|ひ}はコーンスープが{恋|こい}しくなる。
examples.english: On cold days I start craving corn soup.

examples.japanese: セットのスープはコーンスープとオニオンスープから{選|えら}べます。
examples.english: For the set you can choose between corn soup and onion soup.

notes:
From English "corn soup." Japanese uses スープを{飲|の}む (literally "drink soup"), not {食|た}べる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コーンスープを{飲|の}む: to have corn soup
- インスタントのコーンスープ: instant corn soup
- コーンポタージュ: corn potage — the thick, creamy style, and the usual vending-machine version
- {粒入|つぶい}りコーンスープ: corn soup with whole kernels in it

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ポタージュ: potage — any thick, puréed soup; コーンスープ is the best-known example
- コンソメ: consommé — the clear, thin counterpart
